# ProfileEnable

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ProfileEnable:Void enable:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enable` | In | Int32 | required | 1 to run the timers, 0 to stop them. |

## Description

Turns the timers of the runtime on or off while the program runs. The timers measure how long [UpdateWorld](UpdateWorld), [RenderWorld](RenderWorld), [Flip](Flip) and the other parts of the runtime take, and are what [ProfileFPS](ProfileFPS) reports. Off, they cost nothing. A program that was compiled with `--profile` (or `-d`) starts with them on; use this to measure just one part of the program.

Without `--profile` this command does nothing, so a program can keep its calls in a release build.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 64, 64, 0, 2
ProfileFPS 1
ProfileEnable 0 ; not measured: loading
; ... load everything ...
ProfileEnable 1 ; measured from here on
For i = 1 To 100
	Cls
	Flip
Next
```
